verdict.rationale: The evidence shows APIs for sending events and decisions and for reading risk scores. Workflows and Review Queues exist, but nothing documents programmatic creation or updating of rules or lists, such as proposing a velocity rule or editing a blocklist. Nothing documents human approval gates on agent-made rule or list changes either. Review Queues are for reviewing flagged users, not for approving configuration changes, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my fraud posture and manage rules and lists programmatically — propose a velocity rule, update a blocklist — with human approval gates
